page: UpCloud PREMIUM-80xCPU-512GB is a high-capacity x86_64 server based on the KVM hypervisor. It features 80 physical AMD EPYC 9575F cores with a base speed of 2.0 GHz, configured with one thread per core and a shared CPU allocation. The system is equipped with 512 GB of RAM, yielding 6.4 GB per core, and includes a bundled 500 GB local SSD. Network connectivity is supported by one complimentary public IPv4 address.

Benchmark data indicates top-tier multi-core CPU performance, with stress-ng multi-core and Geekbench multi-core scores placing in the top 10%. Single-core performance is also strong, ranking in the top 10% for Geekbench single-core and top 25% for stress-ng single-core tests. The server excels in parallelized tasks, achieving top-tier results in software compilation, ray tracing, image processing, and bzip3 decompression. However, memory performance is more moderate, with the PassMark memory score falling in the average range, and large-block memory write bandwidth registering in the top 25%.

A key tradeoff is the shared CPU allocation, which may introduce resource contention despite the high physical core count. Additionally, LLM text generation speeds for both 135M and 7B models are weak, placing in the bottom 25%, indicating that this server is not optimal for real-time generative AI inference without dedicated GPU acceleration. Conversely, the high core density and strong database operation benchmarks make it highly cost-efficient for heavy multi-threaded workloads, software development pipelines, static web serving, and large-scale data processing.
